phase: Phase 1: SIH PS Requirements & System Scope
description: Catalog of BIS-specific domain knowledge facts that the assistant must acquire dynamically from authoritative BIS sources to satisfy PS capabilities.

applies_to: Domestic & foreign manufacturing units requiring factory inspection & standard mark licence (CM/L)

domain_elements.statutory_basis: BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018, Scheme II & MeitY Orders
applies_to: Electronic, information technology, and photovoltaic goods requiring test report-based self-declaration (R-number)
Gold and silver jewellery and bullion hallmarking by Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC)

domain_elements.statutory_basis: Section 16 of BIS Act 2016 issued by Central Ministries (DPIIT, MeitY, MoS, etc.)
applies_to: Statutory orders published in The Gazette of India mandating compulsory standard mark compliance

domain_elements.statutory_basis: Hallmarking Orders issued under BIS Act 2016
applies_to: Laser-etched 6-digit alphanumeric unique identifier for each article of hallmarked jewellery

domain_elements.statutory_basis: Guidelines for Grant of Licence issued by BIS CMD
applies_to: Specific grouping guidelines, factory testing facilities, and sample sizing for Scheme-I products

domain_elements.statutory_basis: Prescribed quality control schedules under Scheme-I licenses
applies_to: Mandatory routine, acceptance, and raw material testing frequencies for operative licences

domain_elements.statutory_basis: BIS Laboratory Policy & Conformity Assessment Regulations
applies_to: Accredited Central, Regional, and third-party partner laboratories with verified test scopes

domain_elements.statutory_basis: BIS Consumer Affairs Branch & Public Ledgers
applies_to: Public verification of CM/L licence numbers, CRS R-numbers, HUID codes, and complaint redressal
